dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' shaped rings are distributed across the dorsal-lateral surface. The most prominent structures exhibit a high-intensity white perimeter with a jagged, non-uniform geometry. The gradient transitions from a low-intensity dark exterior pelt to the high-intensity light boundary, which then shifts to a low-intensity dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters along the upper dorsal ridge. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack an internal gradient. The concentration of these blobs is highest near the anterior-dorsal region and becomes more sparse and isolated toward the ventral-lateral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest and most defined annuli on the mid-lateral flank form a scalene triangle. The geometry of this relationship is defined by two points aligned near the mid-line and a third, more superiorly positioned point towards the dorsal ridge.
